flashcard_questions.q: Physical, tangible products that are manufactured from raw materials and can be touched, such as cars, phones, or clothing.
Intangible activities provided by a business in return for payment, such as insurance, haircuts, or transport.
The process of turning raw materials and components into finished goods that can be sold to customers.

flashcard_questions.a: A production method where one product is made at a time, individually crafted to the customer’s exact specifications by skilled workers.
A production method where a set number of identical products are made together as a group, with machines changed between batches to produce different items.
